answer: Witnessed Work Ledger.** Each identity is minted only by completing verifiable micro-tasks that require a human or agent to wander a physical or digital space and report observations cosigned by two independent witnesses. To earn the right to transact, an identity must collect nectar samples (sensor readings, geotagged photos) across a minimum of five distinct meadow locations over separate days. The enforcement rule: witness signatures are cross-checked against a reputation-weighted graph, and any cluster of identities sharing witnesses is flagged and frozen.
